title: MV A request for help regarding the game mechanics

posts.author: oftens
posts.body:
I am currently working on my game. In terms of game mechanics, I want to design a passive effect for a set, with the specific effect being: attack and speed will increase by 5% each round.
I am currently using yep's plug-in about buff and state. I have learned a lot of combat mechanics from yanfly's skills, but unfortunately I still have a headache with the code.
If I want to implement this passive state mechanism, how should I set the code?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just as a tip, this is not considered a game mechanics question. Each of the forum sections has a
pinned post
with the guidelines for that section, and this one says:
Since you're asking how to do something with a specific plugin, it should be a Plugin Support thread.
All that being said, you can't do it just with Yanfly's plugins. You'd need to combine Auto Passive States with something like
Hakuen Studio's Dynamic Parameters.
I haven't worked with the plugin myself, but you'd set it up in the plugin parameters for that state, and you can reference
$gameTroop.turnCount()
for the current turn.
@Eliaquim
might be able to help you format the plugin parameter to do what you want.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
If you follow
@ATT_Turan
suggestion, you can do this with my plugin:
- Create a template on the plugin parameters
- Put the formula as it shows on the screenshot on the Attack or any other parameter you want.
- Attach that Template name to a State note field.
I just don't know if it will work with Yanfly Passive states. I never used both together.
